brief: Prioritise Penrose Park for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under heat exposure, as outlined in MG-023. Review its open defect register under SOP-016 to re-prioritise any outstanding work affecting its ability to shed heat. If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, in accordance with MG-023.
